answer: Because the cipher release is entered with every signature, the plume audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the wharf graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The deposit is 19 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
